sources.model: Frozen turbulence (Taylor's hypothesis): the gust field is a fixed seeded pattern carried downwind by the mean wind, so wind speed and direction at (position, time) are a pure function of both and a gust reaches a boat downwind of it later. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor%27s_frozen_turbulence_hypothesis is the idea; the pattern itself is smoothed value noise (quintic fade) at two scales, not a measured turbulence spectrum.
sources.gustAmplitude/minFactor: TUNING GUESS: speed factor = 1 + gustAmplitude * n, n in about [-1, 1] (standard deviation about 0.35), so about +/-17% typical and about +/-40% in the strongest gusts and lulls at gust strength 1; floored at minFactor. No measured gust factor for Laser sailing is stored in docs/.
sources.gustLengthM/fineLengthM/fineWeight: TUNING GUESS: 90 m primary gust size plus a 35 m component at 0.4 weight, so a patch crosses a boat in a 7 kn wind in about 25 s.
sources.gustVeerDeg: TUNING GUESS: a full-strength gust turns the wind clockwise by up to this much (stronger gusts veer), scaled by the gust strength.
sources.shifts: TUNING GUESS: slow time-only oscillation of the wind direction, a sum of two sine waves (5 deg / 280 s and 3 deg / 97 s) with seeded phases, scaled by the shift strength. Position independent.
sources.visual: VISUAL ESTIMATE, render only: gust speed factors are sampled from the same sim function into a 64 x 64 world-anchored single-channel texture with 10 m cells (about 640 m across, fading out over the last 6 cells); referenceDeviation 0.5 is the speed-factor deviation that fills the texture range. The water body colour darkens by up to darkenMax in gusts (ruffled water scatters light) and brightens by lullBrighten in lulls.
